email.body1:
Shannon, saw Mployer publish the 2026 Benefit Plan Design Study across 50,000-plus employer plans.

Data and content pushes like that usually open more accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Mployer off your content and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Shannon, quick follow-up for Mployer.

With new research to drive demand, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most sales leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Mployer needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Shannon, last bit of proof for Mployer.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mployer's reply rate likely compares to other early-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
